week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 8.7 percentage points apart on Seattle at Las Vegas.

rest.headline: Buffalo projects to 13.3 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: New England's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 61%. Buffalo is the Super Bowl favorite at 13%.
